---
title: Built-in Version Extension Test
format: html
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      dom-parity: true
      noErrors: true
      # The real build version (GH #942), not the former {0,1,0} placeholder.
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ["The current version is \\d+\\.\\d+\\.\\d+\\."]
        - ["0\\.1\\.0"]
---

The current version is {{< version >}}.
